english: What is it, Houki-san, this talk...?
Ah, yeah... as fellow students of the sword,\nI wanted everyone's opinions...
What's this about?
It's about Nine... actually,\nNine saved me the other day,\nand I haven't thanked her yet...
Um...
At this point, I don't even know\nwhat face I'm supposed to make when I say thanks...
Huh. I wondered what this 'consultation' was about, and it's about that?
Jehanne...
But I... kinda get\nwhat Houki's saying.
Just say it to their face.\n'Thank you.'\nThat's all it takes.
If I could say that,\nI wouldn't be consulting you!
If you really want to say it, I'm sure you can.
If there's a feeling you want to get across,\nputting it into words matters too...
Right.\nI don't think you need to overthink it.
...Y-yeah... everyone, thank you.
N-Nain.\nT-the other day, you got me out of a tight spot...\nA-ah, thank you!
Don't mention it. ...Same here.\nThe other day, Shirayuki helped me out.
It's nothing.\nOh - if you're going to say that,\nthen I should polish Jehanne's sword...
Thank you... Jehanne.
A-ah, right.\nThen I'll give Tsubasa some pointers in unarmed combat.\nI-I'm grateful. Tsubasa.
W-well, Houki's always been kind to me too...
W-well, if we're saying that, then I...\nyour side dishes, always...
And I... always get the dust brushed off my shoulders...
And I get... medicine that's good for the voice...
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you...
